title: Qualitative incident-response audit example

evidence.title: Incident description A
evidence.description: The supplied description reports that two teams each expected the other to contact the customer; no timestamps were supplied.

findings.title: Ownership needs clarification
findings.statement: The description supports investigating ambiguous handoff responsibility, but does not establish the incident cause.
limitations: Selection and representativeness of the description are unknown.
next_steps: Compare both workflow proposals against the original handoff record.

limitations: No duration estimates or causal confidence scores can be derived.
next_steps: Obtain the workflow definitions and corroborating observations.
